name: Soulsearing Light
descriptionTemplate: Deal [Damage:Arg1] DMG to all enemies and draw 2 Command Cards with the lowest Arithmetica Cost.
lore: Juliette once declared this world fouled, and that the Church's sacred mission is to cleanse it of sin. He is the Divus, the Lightbearer's own chosen—a veteran of countless trials, a vessel of the sacred spirit. His silent prayers alone can move the faithful to tears of gratitude. So let that spirit burn like a wick, pouring forth His divine grace, for where such radiance shines, pure blessings are sure to follow.
